instruction:
look at `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\base.PrjPcb` in Altium Designer. Using `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\variants.json`, create three project variants in Variant Manager - `Standard`, `Lite`, and `Medical` - and save the result as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\variants.PrjPcb`.

Requirements:
- Preserve the original base project sections (`Design`, `Preferences`, and `Document1..Document3`).
- Create variants whose names and descriptions exactly match `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\variants.json`.
- For each listed component, set fitted\DNP state, alternate component, and parameter overrides so the variant behavior matches `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\variants.json` exactly.
- In particular:
- `Standard`: all components remain fitted; `R3` gets `Tolerance=1%`.
- `Lite`: `R2`, `C2`, `U2`, and `D2` are not fitted; `R2` uses alternate component `RES-0402-10K`; `U2` uses alternate component `TL074-SOIC14`.
- `Medical`: all components remain fitted; `U1` uses alternate component `STM32L071-LQFP64`; `Q1` uses alternate component `NMOS-SOT23-AEC`; `R1` and `R3` get `Tolerance=0.1%`.
